verdict.rationale: Convex documents a managed reactive database with nothing to set up. A new project is provisioned via `npm create convex@latest`, and a dev deployment is pushed automatically by the CLI. Convex provides both server functions and client libraries across many frameworks and languages, plus HTTP endpoints, with ACID transactional writes. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the provisioning and client/server SDK read/write flow (community evidence only discusses the reactivity model).

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a managed database and read/write it from client and server SDKs

citations.quote: Convex provides a database, a place to write your server functions, and client libraries.
There is nothing to set up and no need to write any SQL.
Using your favorite languages: JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin, Rust
Server-side data fetching is automatically cached with full consistency, server-side mutators are fully transactional
moving data between the client and server on WebSockets, state management on the client, and pushing changes for live updates.
